item.text: {"summary":"Draft is mostly publishable, but it should explicitly address the time-series/model-prior choice and tighten one evidence-to-update claim before publication.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"model_prior","severity":"warning","summary":"The draft uses a September same-month persistence prior, but it does not explicitly say whether a broader time-series/model prior was used or ruled out.","actionRequested":"Add one sentence explaining why no separate AR/trend/monthly time-series model is used, or state the model prior and how it affects the point estimate."},{"rubricItem":"update","severity":"warning","summary":"The +25 adjustment relies on FY2026 being about USD 170B worse through July, but the draft does not show the supporting arithmetic or cite the compared FY2025/FY2026 cumulative deficit values in the reasoning.","actionRequested":"Add the specific through-July FY2025 and FY2026 cumulative deficit figures, or soften the +25 adjustment if the evidence is only directional."}],"optionalSuggestions":["Clarify whether the registered adapter already returns deficit-positive usd_billions despite the Table 1 published value being surplus-positive USD millions, since the sourceBinding transform says factor 1 while the reasoning applies -0.001.","The interval method is acceptable, but note that the 2019-2025 sample is only seven observations and includes COVID/payment-timing outliers."]}
